title: Club Registration Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture club placement, sponsor route, meeting schedule, and participation need; confirm dismissal and membership review.
description: Club Registration records club placement, sponsor route, meeting schedule, participation need, dismissal, and membership review. Club Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this club registration controlled information handoff when staff must document club placement and sponsor route. Reconcile meeting schedule, participation need, dismissal, and membership review before the club registration handoff. Use the membership request, capacity roster, sponsor confirmation, meeting schedule, support-routing acknowledgment, dismissal choice, and welcome-message receipt. This registration establishes recurring membership, sponsor governance, meeting cadence, student eligibility, dues handling, after-meeting dismissal, and membership renewal. Ask the assigned club registration reviewer to confirm club placement against the organization's policy.
